DLNM models for each Argentinean sub-ecoregion

The Patagonian steppe may be divided into two parts, north and south (Burkart 1999), resulting in a total of 25 subecoregions in the Argentinean territory.

Statistical models

We fitted a DLNM model for each subecoregion in the country. DLNM models with lag = 2 were used for stunting while DLNM models with lag = 3 were used for wasting. Results are shown as a cumulative relative risk (RR) curve and heatmaps including the lag decomposition. Also, as a final result, we include the Attributable Fraction (AF) meta-analysis.

Stunting results

stunting <- meta_analisis_AF(subecos, nut = 'bt')

Wasting results

Relative Risk (RR) meta-analysis

We also conducted a RR relative risk analysis. We assesed how the RR changed given a hypothetical scenario where the temperature drops from the median to the lower 2.5 percentile and also where the temperature rises from the median to the upper 97.5 percentile.

Stunting RR meta-analysis

resultados_bt <- map(subecos_filtrados, ~ajustar_modelo_SUBECOREG(bd_mes_filtrada, 
                                                           .x,
                                                           retardo_lag = 2,
                                                           nut = 'bt',
                                                           temp = 'temp_media',
                                                           family = 'binomial'))

meta_bt <- meta_analisis(bd_mes_filtrada, resultados_bt, k = 3)
